description: This file defines a React functional component named TenantSelection that manages the display and selection of tenants for a user session. It fetches tenant data from an API, handles user interactions for tenant selection, and navigates upon successful selection.

methods.name: TenantSelection()
methods.description: React functional component that renders tenant selection UI, fetches tenant data on load, handles tenant selection, and navigation.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches tenant data from API and updates component state.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Function called when a tenant is selected; performs tenant selection API call and navigates to dashboard.
